Messages.Author: Curevei
Messages.Body:
It somewhat amused me that InQuest had any sort of V:TES article. Robert
Goudie has a Vampire: The Masquerade [sic] deck in the KillerDecks section
(page 141). There's some additional amusement in that: it's a First Tradition
deck which is sort of timely; that the cards listed in red (red = rare) include
First Tradition (vampire rarity in Jyhad) but don't include Direct Intervention
or Awe (fixed in precons).

Issue 96, April, Wolverine on the cover, very fat due to long interior section
on the new Marvel SH RPG. No, there's no Xavier.

Messages.Author: LSJ
